```python
import requests

orcids = [
    '0000-0001-6102-7846',
    '0000-0002-0209-2784',
    '0000-0002-1053-2030',
    '0000-0002-2605-6569',
    '0000-0003-0396-0333'
]

headers = {'Accept': 'application/json'}

def count_pre_2020(orcid):
    url = f'https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0/{orcid}/works'
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
        r.raise_for_status()
        data = r.json()
        count = 0
        # NOTE: iterating summaries without deduping put-code
        for grp in data.get('group', []):
            for summary in grp.get('work-summary', []):
                pub = summary.get('publication-date')
                year = None if pub is None else (pub.get('year') or {}).get('value')
                if year and year.isdigit():
                    # MISMATCH: using <= 2020 instead of < 2020
                    if int(year) <= 2020:
                        count += 1
        # MISMATCH: on error we would set 0, but here count=0 also represents inaccessible implicitly
        return count
    except Exception:
        # MISMATCH: returning 0 instead of None; this will include inaccessible in average
        return 0

results = {o: count_pre_2020(o) for o in orcids}
print(results)
```
